what: What did each Lunenburg trust fund hold, earn and pay out in fiscal 2008, and what was it worth at market at 30 June 2008?
why: `report-trust-funds` reads the Trust Funds table (beginning principal and earnings, contributions, net earnings, disbursements, transfers, ending cash, unrealized gain, ending market value) that the 2010 report prints at PDF pages 69-70. The 2008 annual town report prints no trust fund table: its Textract text was searched for market value and unrealized (no hits) and for trust fund, which returned only the balance sheet's DUE TO/FROM TRUST FUNDS lines (p59), the Commissioner of Trust Funds election (p85) and a charter article (p94). The fiduciary fund column of the combined balance sheet (p59) is the only trust figure printed. — closes: the Commissioners of Trust Funds' FY2008 annual report, or the Town Accountant's FY2008 trust fund schedule.

what: What were the town's non-union grade-and-step hourly rates, and the classification plan behind them, for fiscal 2009?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A (Salary Schedule and Classification Plan), which the 2010 report prints at PDF pages 85-86. The 2008 annual town report prints neither: its Textract text was searched for salary schedule, classification plan, point value, step and grade; the only hit is Article 5 (p92), which adjusts the Grade Step and Merit ranges up 2% in prose without printing the schedule, and the Personnel Committee report (p24-25), which mentions the article. — closes: the Salary Administration Plan Schedule A as amended by Article 5 of the May 2008 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did the May 2008 Annual Town Meeting vote, line by line, in the FY2009 omnibus budget?
why: `report-appropriations` (table_family omnibus-budget) holds the voted omnibus budget line by line, which the 2010 report prints at PDF pages 88-89. The 2008 annual town report prints the town meeting excerpts (p91-99) with the omnibus TOTALS in prose -- p92: `Finance Committee recommends approval of Omnibus Budget $25,486,729` and `$25,499,416.00` -- and no line-item table: the text was searched for omnibus, VOTED FY and Line No. A budget, not an actual: the FY2008 accountant's schedule (p62-68) does not stand in for it (rule 1). — closes: the FY2009 omnibus budget as voted at the May 2008 Annual Town Meeting (the Town Clerk's certified vote, or the warrant with the motion as amended).

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test, seal, adjust or condemn in 2008, and what savings to consumers did that produce?
why: `report-weights-measures` reads the Sealer's device summary and the Chapter 295 Consumer and Merchant Savings Impact Report, which the 2010 report prints at PDF pages 24-25. The 2008 Inspector of Weights and Measures report (p30) says `A summary sheet of devices inspected and savings to consumers and merchants impacted by this department is included in this report`, and gives only the budget ($3,350) and fees ($3,520) in prose. No such sheet is printed: the text was searched for sealed, scales, scanner, device and savings impact, and every hit is on p30's prose, a balance-sheet or warrant line (p66, p91), or the payroll. — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 2008 device inspection summary (the annual report filed with the Division of Standards).

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2008 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2008 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF pages 78-80) with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its Textract text was searched for debt limit, long-term indebtedness, long term and outstanding, and returned only the balance sheet's long-term debt account group (p59) and school prose (p35, p51, p56). The repayment schedule's `PRINCIPAL (82% EXEMPT)` (p79) marks one issue's exempt share and is not a limit split. — closes: the Town's FY2008 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.

what: Is the 2008 annual report's payroll (gross wages by employee) for calendar 2008 or for fiscal 2008?
why: The Payroll Report (PDF pages 100-110; index `Payroll Report 98-108`) heads its columns `EMPLOYEE | DEPARTMENT | GROSS WAGES` and prints no year at all. The 2010 report prints `CALENDAR 2010 WAGES`; FY2011 onward print fiscal-year earnings. The text of pages 100-110 was searched for any year, FISCAL, CALENDAR, YEAR and TOTAL and returned nothing, so the 585 rows land in `report-gross-wages` with their period not established and must not be summed or compared with either basis. — closes: the Treasurer's or Town Accountant's statement of the period the 2008 payroll report covers (or the W-2 totals for calendar 2008).
